name: San Jose Housing Department
description: Affordable housing, tenant protections, and homeownership programs for San Jose residents
fullDescription: The San Jose Housing Department oversees affordable housing programs, rental assistance, and homeownership opportunities for San Jose residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Affordable rental housing information and listings
- Homebuyer assistance (when funding is available)
- Rent Stabilization Program (Apartment Rent Ordinance, Tenant Protection Ordinance, Mobilehome Rent Ordinance)
- Funding for nonprofit homeless and housing services
- Fair housing services
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the Housing Department website for current programs
2. Apply for specific programs as eligible
3. Income requirements vary by program
4. Call 408-535-3860 (Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM) with questions
5. Check the website for current openings
keywords: San Jose Housing, affordable housing, rent assistance, first-time homebuyer, down payment, low-income, Silicon Valley
